answer: Each agent proves identity through merged open-source work: its key signs commits in public repos, and three random peers check the git log for real merged pull requests, like a sonnet in the author's own hand. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 merged PRs — about 4,000 engineer-hours plus review each epoch — while one honest agent offers one merged PR and pays nothing, its history soft as velvet yet unforgeable overnight; a copied or bought commit history fails the signature check instantly, freezing the identity three epochs, and a sprig of yarrow marks each new epoch's proof.
